changes: Removed the user-facing transregional historical-systems category.
Assigned the Russian Empire, Soviet Union and Russian Federation only to Eastern Europe.
Kept the Ottoman Empire only in Western Asia and Yugoslavia only in the Balkans/Southeastern Europe.
Renamed the British navigation unit to United Kingdom; central British awards remain under it while distinct colonial or local awarding authorities remain local.
Collapsed Meiji, Taisho, Showa and modern Japan into one continuous Japan catalogue section.
Removed empty pre-modern Japan and Joseon nodes and replaced the generic China historical placeholder with the evidenced Manchukuo awarding polity.
Expanded Central America, the Caribbean, South America and sub-Saharan Africa into explicit country discovery units.
classification_rule: Geography follows the principal centre of the awarding authority. Place of service or occupation alone does not create a new award system.
